description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.44.0-dev.4-dualvot.8.5.3

Compatibility hotfix for YouTube 21.37.42.

### Fixed

- Fixed regular videos and Shorts failing to load on YouTube 21.37.42.
- Fixed the app crash when swiping to the next Short.
- Updated the internal Yandex VoT media-transport hook to resolve obfuscated
  DataSpec fields and constructor parameter registers dynamically.
- Preserved compatibility with YouTube 21.36.45 and earlier supported builds.

### Validation

- The fixed MPP was tested on an Android device with YouTube 21.37.42.
- Regular videos and Shorts load normally, and swiping between Shorts no
  longer crashes.
- Structural regression checks cover dynamic field and register resolution.
